text:
Tessa: Hi team — I'm two weeks into onboarding and the open floor is getting really overwhelming. Noise + frequent quick standups are causing sensory overload and I'm missing context in async threads. It's starting to affect my PR quality and turnaround. Can we talk accommodations? Prefer a quiet desk, a couple scheduled low-notif blocks, and a slightly longer code-review SLA while I ramp.

Marcus: Thanks for flagging this, Tessa — I'm your manager. We absolutely can make adjustments. I'll cover your oncall for the next two weeks and reassign review triage. Please loop in @People Ops so we can do the formal steps. 🙏

People Ops: Hi Tessa — thanks for sharing and doing so early. We can start the ADA interactive process; we'll keep everything confidential. Practical options we often use: temporary quiet desk or private room reservation, calendar focus blocks, adjusted review SLAs, and small schedule tweaks. We'll need a short accommodation request form (link) and manager confirmation. EAP is available if you want counseling support. I'll DM you the form and next steps.

Tessa: Thanks Marcus + People Ops. Quiet desk sounds ideal. I also wanted to ask about how this will be reflected in the next performance calibration — I don't want a temporary ramp issue to hurt my review.

People Ops: Good question. We can add a ramp-aware note in the calibration pack: manager sets adjusted objectives for the next 2–4 weeks and documents the accommodation start date. We don't have to change your official cycle; we formally record the accommodation and make calibration teams aware. We'll provide a short template note you can share with your manager.

HR-Bot: Request created — ticket ID HR-2026-482. Please upload documentation if you choose (optional). Track request: https://redwood/hr/requests/HR-2026-482

Jordan: happy to help with PR triage and async reviews while you ramp. I can take paired review sessions M/W mornings if that helps.

Samir: small ask — can we move the 10am standup to 10:30 for this week? Might make it easier for Tessa to join after a short focus block. :slightly_smiling_face:

Marcus: I can shift standup this week and will mark on the team board that Tessa is on a modified review SLA for two weeks. I'll also cover any urgent pages.

People Ops: Next steps (timeline): 1) Tessa completes the accommodation form (link in HR-Bot). 2) Marcus confirms coverage and enters the calibration note. 3) People Ops will reserve a quiet desk/private room and update Tessa's calendar; expect confirmation within 48 hours. We'll set weekly 30-min check-ins for the first 2 weeks to gauge if adjustments are sufficient. If anything urgent comes up, DM People Ops.

Tessa: Really appreciate this — I'll submit the form today and upload anything optional. Thank you everyone for the quick responses. :heart:
